entity.summary: Open-source self-custody wallet ecosystem combining hardware signing devices with the OneKey software wallet.
entity.notes: First-party fundamentals state that OneKey hardware devices and the OneKey App have served users since 2020.

products.summary: Current premium OneKey hardware wallet with touchscreen, secure elements and multiple signing/connectivity modes.
products.notes: Current first-party product material establishes an active purchasable OneKey Pro; initial product launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: OneKey Wallet 6.5.2 released
events.description: The official OneKey app monorepo published OneKey Wallet 6.5.2 on 2026-08-21 with signed packaged wallet builds across Android and desktop platforms. Current canonical products model OneKey Pro hardware but not the software app, so this lifecycle event is intentionally entity-level and is not attached to OneKey Pro.

evidence.title: OneKey fundamentals

evidence.title: OneKey Pro Hardware Wallet
